structured_output.mechanisms: Time = per-epoch compute (conv FLOPs from channel widths plus a first-layer activation/memory term) times epochs, scaled by a resolution-curriculum factor (24px phases cost ~0.56x) plus resize/selection overhead, plus per-step overhead (smaller batches cost more), plus Muon cost. Accuracy rises with epochs and width, falls with low-res phases, cutout, random flip, off-optimal label smoothing; Muon adds accuracy.
